exposure: Different types of cervical transformation zones (TZs)
outcome: Optimal conization length for negative margins
cohort: 618 women with or suspicion of cervical precancer from five medical centers in Shanghai, China, between July 2016 and September 2019
finding: A cervical excision length of 10-15 mm is reasonable for TZ1 and TZ2 patients, while 17-25 mm is optimal for TZ3 excision to achieve negative internal margins.
who: Women with or suspicion of cervical precancer
